How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my traineeship host

questions.question: How easy was it to find housing? *
questions.answer: I was offered an apartment already during the first meeting, which made the process very smooth. While it is possible to find accommodation independently, Hannover is relatively expensive, and it can be difficult for foreigners to secure housing for a short stay

questions.question: Additional comments:
How relevant did you find your traineeship for your future employment prospects? *
questions.answer: The traineeship offered me unique opportunities to gain in-depth knowledge of small animal reproduction through hands-on experience at a specialized clinic - something not available in Denmark. Additionally, I participated in a range of laboratory tasks and deepened my understanding of the scientific process by collaborating with professors, PhD students, and postdoctoral researchers.

questions.question: How relevant did you find your traineeship for your academic programme at UCPH *
questions.answer: Very relevant, it was very well connected to UCPH.

questions.question: Additional comments
How well did the academic level at UCPH coincide with the tasks completed during your traineeship? *
questions.answer: The academic level at UCPH aligned closely with the tasks I completed during my traineeship.

questions.question: Please elaborate *
questions.answer:
My specialization in Biomedicine equipped me with a comprehensive scientific toolkit - including analytical methods, statistical evaluation, and knowledge of various laboratory techniques - which provided a strong basis for understanding and performing my work.
Having completed all theoretical and practical training in Denmark, I was well prepared and had a solid foundation for active participation in the clinic

Additional comments:
questions.answer: I did a lot of training - running, bouldering and cycling, and there were multiple more opportunities.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available at your traineeship destination (organization/city/region)? *
questions.answer:
Cultural:
- The city had multiple activities, almost every weekend. Different art exhibitions, concerts, lantern celebration.

Athletics:
- Bouldering, fitness, good running and cycling paths, swimming, many areas for hiking

Social:
- Different excursions to cities nearby arranged by the university, different dinner parties arranged by the professors and the students

questions.question: Which non-academic activities would you recommend to future trainees visiting the same destination (organization/city/region)? Why? *
questions.answer:
Hiking in Deister (Pretty, and with high towers with great views)
Climbing in the Beta Boulderhall (it is giant, and it is so good and much cheaper than in DK!)
Trying Buddha Bowl (delicious asian food)
Taking walks, runs and cycling tours around Eilenreide (Sooo nice with a lot of forest and parks around you!)
Erlebnis Zoo Hannover (really nice zoo, a bit expensive though)
Tiergarten Hannover (really nice park with deers and wild boars - for free)
Free concerts at different bars
Seeing the new Radhaus (really nice view from outside and inside, with different versions of Hannover through time)
Going to Harzen (nice for Hiking)
Visit to Bremen and Hamburg

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting trainees see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: All of the above!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your trainee host? *
questions.answer: It was very easy, Hannover and the inhabitants are very similar to Denmark.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of the destination (city/country)? *
questions.answer: It was very easy, Hannover and the inhabitants are very similar to Denmark.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with locals? *
questions.answer: Yes, get involved with the students and let them show you their favorite places. Go out alone for restaurant visits and for different activities; they are all very friendly, so you will most likely find some new friends.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Honesty and the kindness.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going on a traineeship to the same city/region? *
questions.answer:
Remember to enjoy yourself and make the most of your time!
Join social activities to meet new people and build connections.
Also, consider buying the Deutschlandticket (60 EUR/month) - it gives you access to all regional trains, metros, buses, S-trains, and U-Bahns across Germany.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future traineeship students? *
questions.answer: (an extra one: Bring a bike or borrow one - Hannover has great cycling paths)

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your traineeship experience? *
questions.answer:
The great people I met
The academic challenges

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the traineeship? *
questions.answer: The academic challenges (getting used to think in a certain manner), and speaking german.

questions.question: Is there anything UCPH could have done different (before/during/after) in regard to the traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: It would be great if it was easier to get information from UCPH before you leave. Otherwise it has been great.

questions.answer: Yes
